DexArena Wiki

Technical documentation for tasks, data, training, evaluation, and future submissions.

Canonical scope

The formal collection target is exactly 10 long-horizon environments plus 30 stage environments. Compatibility aliases and retired curricula are excluded.

Recommended workflow

  1. Install the environment and check available assets and data.
  2. Read the configuration contract and run a small evaluation.
  3. Adapt your model using Policy integration, then evaluate the three benchmark tracks.
  4. Record per-episode evidence and follow the leaderboard protocol.
